gloss: rain shelter; rain guard; rain cover

definitions.gloss: rain shelter; rain guard; rain cover
definitions.explanation: Something that provides protection from rain — a shelter, awning, cover, or other structure or device that keeps rain off.

examples.japanese: {雨|あま}よけの{下|した}で{待|ま}った。
examples.english: I waited under a rain shelter.

examples.japanese: ベビーカーに{雨|あま}よけカバーをつけた。
examples.english: I put a rain cover on the stroller.

examples.japanese: {玄関|げんかん}に{雨|あま}よけの{庇|ひさし}があるので、{荷物|にもつ}を{出|だ}し{入|い}れするときに{濡|ぬ}れなくて{済|す}む。
examples.english: There's a rain awning over the entrance, so I don't get wet when bringing things in and out.

notes:
Composed of {雨|あま} (rain) + よけ (avoidance, protection). The suffix よけ ({除|よ}け) means protection against or warding off, and combines with many nouns to describe protective measures.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {雨|あま}よけカバー: rain cover
- {雨|あま}よけの{庇|ひさし}: rain awning
- {雨|あま}よけテント: rain shelter tent
- {雨|あま}よけになる: to serve as rain protection

RELATED WORDS WITH よけ:
- {日|ひ}よけ: sunshade, sun protection
- {風|かぜ}よけ: windbreak
- {虫|むし}よけ: insect repellent
- {魔|ま}よけ: charm against evil
